_about: Decision D11. What is in git, what is not, and how everything that is not in git is made again. Read by tools/maintenance/reproducible.py (wsl python3 tools/maintenance/reproducible.py). Script paths are relative to the problem folder. status: scripted = a tracked script makes it from its inputs; recipe = made again by a run (ledger row + tag + run.json); partial = scripted in part, see note; missing = no script yet.

clone_checks.name: compile all code (python 3.12, gcar)
clone_checks.cmd: source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate gcar && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m compileall -q training evaluation tools reports/build temp

clone_checks.name: structure and documents (check_structure)
clone_checks.why: documents of experiments name logs, images and results that exist only on disk (by rule not in git); in the working tree the check has 0 problems

clone_checks.name: grid metric reproduces stored numbers
clone_checks.why: reads the stored loop-3 dense output runs/e37_final (717 MB, not in git, rebuilt only by re-running E37); see artifact stored_run_outputs

clone_checks.name: stored numbers (golden, cached data, all registry names except control)
clone_checks.cmd: python3 -c "import json;p='evaluation/golden.json';g=json.load(open(p));g['entries']=[e for e in g['entries'] if e['name']!='control'];json.dump(g,open(p,'w'))" && bash tools/env/_py14.sh evaluate.py --golden check --cached-only

clone_checks.name: stored numbers of the control (golden)
clone_checks.why: the control entries read its stored graphs runs/e94_a/graphs_*_clean.pkl: not kept in git (D11: what can be rebuilt is not kept), rebuilt by re-running the E94 evaluation (628 ms per frame)
